turns.text: I'd like to practise a hard parent meeting. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. I'll send END MEETING on its own when I want to stop. I'm Owen's English teacher, and Meredith has just walked into my classroom.
Who decided on the zero, and why did Owen hear about it before I did?
So the defense is that he just types really fast?
I haven't offered a defence, because you haven't shown me anything to defend against. What do you have?
182 words in six minutes. Wow. Maybe he should be a court stenographer.
Don't make jokes about my son. 182 words in six minutes, according to what, and on what date?
There's no theory, Hale, there's a question you keep not answering. Show me where 182 words in six minutes comes from, or stop saying it.
